LESSON: GUIDED WRITING

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: GERMAN
Strand: WRITING Theme 4:Time (Moments of the day) Strand Sub Strand Specific Learning Ou
Topic 3.6: Guided writing
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 1

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Guided writing, part of WRITING Theme 4:Time (Moments of the day) Strand Sub Strand Specific Learning Ou in Grade 5 GERMAN.

Key inquiry question: How does wrong spelling affect communication?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. create compound words with correct orthography,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Guided writing in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. construct short simple sentences for communication,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Guided writing in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. appreciate role of writing in communication.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Guided writing in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. create compound words with correct orthography,

   Guided writing helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

B. construct short simple sentences for communication,

   Guided writing helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

C. appreciate role of writing in communication.

   Guided writing helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

D. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. write meals eaten at different mealtimes at home/school (z.B Frühstück, Mittagessen, Abendessen, Tee/kaffeepause) and share in class,

2. combine two parts of words to form a meaningful word (z.B Abend + Essen + das Abendessen),

3. sketch a menu of favourite mealtime with peers,

4. find dishes in a puzzle,

5. match meals to specific pictures,

6. fill in missing letters to meals,

7. discuss appropriate foods for each mealtime in groups,

8. read simple menus from Kenya/Germany.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. write meals eaten at different mealtimes at home/school (z.B Frühstück, Mittagessen, Abendessen, Tee/kaffeepause) and share in class,
2. combine two parts of words to form a meaningful word (z.B Abend + Essen + das Abendessen),
3. sketch a menu of favourite mealtime with peers,
4. find dishes in a puzzle,
5. match meals to specific pictures,
6. fill in missing letters to meals,
7. discuss appropriate foods for each mealtime in groups,
8. read simple menus from Kenya/Germany.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Guided writing together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Communication and collaboration: Learner develops skills of communicating effectively as they combine two parts of words

to form a meaningful word (z.B Abend + Essen + das Abendessen).

Values:
Unity: Learner works collaboratively as they work with peers to sketch menus of favourite meals.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs)

Healthy Eating Habits: The learner develops an awareness of healthy eating habits as they discuss appropriate foods for each

mealtime in groups.

Link to other Learning Areas

The learner links the concept of healthy eating and meal times to the same concept in Agriculture.
